method: Native Safari and Chrome controlled through CUA. Actual menu-key Copy/Cut/Paste, native clicks and keyboard selection; no synthesized DOM clipboard events or programmatic Selection changes. Payloads checked by pasting into the fixture scratch textarea. All content is disposable sample text. Trusted events alone are not considered proof; visible before/after text and structures were checked.
passedInBothBrowsers: Click Collect your ideas, Command-Left, Command-Shift-Right, Command-C; paste into scratch: exactly Collect your ideas, no bullet marker.
Reselect identically and Command-X: one empty bullet remains, surrounding content unchanged. Paste into scratch: exact text. One toolbar Undo restores the bullet and selection.
Click Write a first draft, Command-Right, Command-V: appends Collect your ideas exactly once to item 3, without adding list structure. One Command-Z restores the original text and items 3/4.

From start of Write a first draft, Shift-Down then Command-Shift-Right selects through end of Review and refine. Copy and external paste produce Write a first draft followed by one newline and Review and refine, without numbered markers.
Reselect the forward range and Cut: leaves one empty item numbered 3. External paste matches the two-line payload. One Undo restores both items, their text, selection and numbering 3/4.

From end of Review and refine, Shift-Up then Command-Shift-Left selects backward through start of Write a first draft. Repeat Copy/external paste and Cut/external paste/one Undo: same exact payload and restored document structure.

accessibilitySelectionControl.conclusion: The accessibility-command mispositioning reproduces without any Breditor runtime. Rust/Wasm is not a necessary cause. This does not yet isolate Safari accessibility implementation versus CUA range translation. The plain page has different default spacing, and the wrong offset differs from the Breditor observation.
accessibilitySelectionControl.chromeSelectionDisplay: Chrome's accessibility selected-text display included 4. in the cross-item selection, but the actual pasted payload excluded it and preserved the newline. Do not use AX selected-text formatting as a clipboard-content oracle.
accessibilitySelectionControl.relationshipToQueueFault: No demonstrated relationship to the separate intermittent queueUncertain failure.

limits: No code fix is claimed: native clipboard scenarios passed, and a separate test-control discrepancy was isolated outside the editor.
Does not qualify physical IME, spoken VoiceOver, native persistence/recovery, or every Chrome formatting interaction.
